verdicts.title: Boundedness of $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano varieties with degrees and alpha-invariants bounded from below
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show that $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano varieties of fixed dimension with anti-canonical degrees and alpha-invariants bounded from below form a bounded family. As a corollary, K-semistable $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano varieties of fixed dimension with anti-canonical degrees bounded from below form a bounded family.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns boundedness of Q-Fano varieties with alpha-invariants and anti-canonical degrees, which is algebraic geometry unrelated to communication complexity or hyperbolic metric distances to the Euclidean plane.

verdicts.title: On non-autonomous maximal regularity for elliptic operators in divergence form
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider the Cauchy problem for non-autonomous forms inducing elliptic operators in divergence form with Dirichlet, Neumann, or mixed boundary conditions on an open subset $Ω$ $\subseteq$ R n. We obtain maximal regularity in L 2 ($Ω$) if the coefficients are bounded, uniformly elliptic, and satisfy a scale invariant bound on their fractional time-derivative of order one-half. Previous results even for such forms required control on a time-derivative of order larger than one-half.
